propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures consume >32 seconds per xdist worker due to large >100MiB object duplication across workers.
The existing large-object guard (>140MiB incompressible blob) cannot be replaced by mocks or config inspection and must remain real Git protocol with packet-trace proof.
Protocol-only test cases can use isolated small ephemeral Git servers instead of duplicating large fixtures, provided each worker has separate temporary repositories and cleanup.

Implementation splits three filter-negotiation/missing-object cases and reconvergence/push to a 1 KiB isolated server, reserving the 141 MiB server for standalone pack-guard tests confined to one xdist worker.
Defect mutation proves size-independence: replacing 1 KiB payload with 141 MiB causes pack oracle to fail, validating that small fixtures detect the same faults.
